$comment: P/U/S codes (SPEC §21). Servers raise the code in the Postgres error detail; clients map it to plain-language copy keyed by messageKey, with the code shown small beneath. P = expected states (informative, never alarming); U = user-fixable (always a next step); S = our fault.

P-100.meaning: Firing a pulse needs an account (browse freely, sign in to act).

P-101.meaning: Signed in but no pulsio_profiles row — the sign-up trigger didn't run; retry creates it.

P-103.meaning: Today's quota and the top-up balance are both used. Next quota at Mauritius midnight.
